== Biography ==
Janet Glasgow is represented on WikiTree as the wife of James Woodside. Her reported dates and Irish birthplace have not been established by a reviewed original record.

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1498]] is assessed at 41% (possible). Inherited uncertain attachment to John-1498; no reviewed source names Janet as his daughter. John’s c 1650 generation fits Janet’s c 1678 estimate and the inherited Scottish-to-Irish family placement. No concrete competing father has been established.

Possible family-tree inference, without a direct parent clause. The corrected Elgin location error is not evidence for or against this father.

Next useful test: Find Janet’s marriage or estate identifying her father or siblings.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-2249 WikiTree profile export for Glasgow-2249]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.



[[Glasgow-1498|John Glasgow]] is documented as a survivor of the 1679 ''Croune of London'' wreck under Cavers parish, Scotland. That prisoner list names no parents or children and gives no later Irish destination. It therefore does not prove that Janet was his daughter; the father link is retained only as uncertain pending a better placement.

An earlier profile version placed Janet's death at Elgin, Illinois, in 1775. This is impossible because Elgin was founded in 1835; the city history is retained below as evidence for excluding that location. The generic baptism collection and memorial previously cited do not supply an original record proving Janet's Irish birth or her father.
